full_prompt_en: A square realist oil painting gathers an adult man and several children in a narrow, weathered doorway. The opening is dark and deep, framed by chalky white plaster on the left and uneven red brick on the right. A worn stone threshold runs along the bottom, with scattered grit and pale broken marks across its surface. On the left foreground, a bearded man in a flat cap and heavy gray brown coat leans toward the group. One hand rests near his hip, and his face turns right to watch the children. In front of the opening, a blond child in a dark jacket stands near the center, hands held close together and eyes lowered. To the right, a red-haired girl bends slightly inward in a white blouse and a full deep green skirt, her folded arms and downward gaze making a compact silhouette. Between and behind them, two smaller children in pale and warm red clothing occupy the threshold, their heads close to one another. More faces emerge above them from the shadowed doorway, only partly visible against the interior darkness. The group overlaps tightly, making the entrance feel crowded but leaving each near face readable. Coarse brick joints, stained plaster and scuffed clothing are all carried by small, irregular brush touches. The children near the front have softly modeled cheeks and hair, while garments dissolve into broader gray, brown and green folds. Light falls from the upper left and outside the doorway, illuminating the front faces, the white blouse and worn wall. The interior behind them stays near black, and the right brick face catches a warm muted glow without hard shadows. The painting uses a restrained palette of earth colors, with red hair and green cloth providing its clearest accents. The overall composition holds the close human cluster between rough vertical walls, balancing tender expressions with the weight of the dark entry and weathered stone.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实油画把一位成年男子和几个孩子聚在狭窄、磨旧的门口。门洞深而暗，左侧由粉白旧灰墙框住，右侧是不齐整的红砖。磨损石门槛沿底部延伸，表面散着沙粒和浅色破碎痕迹。左前方，一位戴平顶帽、穿厚重灰褐外套的络腮胡男子向人群俯身。一只手放在胯边附近，脸转向右侧看孩子们。门口前方，中央附近一名金发孩子穿深色夹克，双手靠在一起，眼睛低垂。右侧，一名红发女孩穿白上衣与蓬起的深绿裙，略向内弯身；收拢的手臂和向下目光形成紧凑剪影。在他们之间及后方，另有两个穿浅色和暖红衣物的小孩子站在门槛上，头靠得很近。还有几张面孔从他们上方的阴影门洞里露出，仅有部分在内部黑暗前可见。人群紧密交叠，让入口显得拥挤，却仍能读清近处每张面孔。粗砖缝、斑驳灰墙与磨旧衣物都由细小不规则笔触表现。前方孩子的脸颊与头发塑形柔和，服装则化成更宽的灰、褐、绿褶面。光从左上及门外落下，照亮前方面孔、白上衣与旧墙。后方室内保持近黑，右侧砖面只接到低调暖光，没有硬投影。画面采用克制土色，红发和绿布成为最明确的强调。整体构图把亲近的人群夹在粗糙竖墙之间，以温柔神情平衡暗门洞和磨旧石面的重量。
style_prompt_en: The image has a realist oil-painted surface with softly modeled focal planes and rougher strokes in surrounding material. Muted umber, olive gray and worn cream dominate, while compact red and deep green accents give the subdued field direction. Dark recesses create strong depth behind tightly overlapping near forms. Edges sharpen where light reaches faces and pale fabric, then break into loose texture across coarse vertical surfaces and shadowed folds. Light enters from one upper outside side, bringing gentle warmth to exposed planes while the interior remains almost black. The brushwork varies from delicate blending to granular scumbling, distinguishing fragile smooth areas from weathered ones. A shallow cluster is organized by narrow upright framing and a solid lower threshold. The overall effect is intimate and sober, with human warmth carried by small lit areas inside heavy earth-colored shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有写实油画表面，焦点平面塑形柔和，周围材质使用更粗松的笔触。低饱和赭褐、橄榄灰和磨旧奶油色占主导，紧凑红色与深绿强调给安静色域指明方向。深色凹处在紧密交叠的近景形体后建立强纵深。光触及的面部与浅布边缘较锐，粗糙竖面和阴影褶皱上的轮廓则破成松散肌理。光从一侧上方的外部进入，使受光平面带温和暖意，内部仍近乎黑色。笔触从精细融合到颗粒干擦不断变化，区分脆弱平滑区域与磨旧区域。浅空间的聚集形体由狭窄竖向框架和坚实下沿组织。整体效果亲近而沉静，厚重土色阴影中的少量亮区承载温度。
theme_en: An adult and several children gathered in a weathered brick doorway
theme_zh: 一位成年人和几个孩子聚在磨旧砖墙门口
name: Frank Holl
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
